title: Canned job leaves out a typed vendor part that matches an inactive part
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user (Admin) · 1 browser · about 20 minutes
  • Build: the Part Lifecycle QA build (no build exists yet; use the build named in the test run).
  • User: [Admin] = you, signed in with the Admin role, which by default has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • Location: [Loc-1] = the location picked in the top-bar location switcher at the start; every step runs at [Loc-1] unless it names another location.
  • Data: [Part-A] = one tracked part, set inactive in Setup. [Part-C] = one tracked part, active.
  • Data: [Job-1] = a canned job holding [Part-C] and a vendor part typed in by hand as [Typed-1], a number that equals [Part-A] once case, hyphens and periods are ignored.
  • Names and numbers marked (e.g. …) are examples only. What must hold is the status (active or inactive), tracking, quantity and link described above.

Setup

  1. Go to Parts → Vendors, click "New Vendor", type Name (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST PL CANVEND Vendor"), click "Save & Close". [Vendor-1] = that vendor.
  2. Go to Parts → Inventory, click "New Inventory Part" and fill in Description (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL CANVEND A), Part Number (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-CANVEND-01), Category (e.g. Uncategorized), Cost (e.g. $10.00), Sell Price (e.g. $20.00); leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on; set the default bin's Quantity to 4; click Save.
  3. [Part-A] = the part number you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-CANVEND-01); [Desc-A] = the description you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL CANVEND A).
  4. Go to Parts → Inventory, click "New Inventory Part" and fill in Description (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL CANVEND C), Part Number (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-CANVEND-03), Category (e.g. Uncategorized), Cost (e.g. $10.00), Sell Price (e.g. $20.00); leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on; set the default bin's Quantity to 4; click Save.
  5. [Part-C] = the part number you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-CANVEND-03); [Desc-C] = the description you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL CANVEND C).
  6. Go to Work Orders, click "New Work Order"; in Customer click Add and create a customer (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST PL CANVENDSRC Customer"); in Asset click Add and create a unit (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST-PL-CANVENDSRC-UNIT"); click Create.
  7. [WO-0] = the work order number shown at the top left (e.g. S2-1234).
  8. On [WO-0] click "New Line", type Title (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST PL CANVENDSRC line"), click "Save & Close". [Line-0] = that line. Click "Approve" on [Line-0].
  9. On [Line-0] open the ⋮ menu, click "Request part", type "zzautotest.pl.canvend.01" in Part Number and press Tab, pick Source "Vendor", Vendor [Vendor-1], Category (e.g. Uncategorized), Cost $8.00, Sell Price $16.00, click "Save Part". [Typed-1] = that typed number.
  10. On [Line-0] open the line's ⋮ menu, click "Request part", type [Part-C] in Part Number, pick the row that shows "Inventory Qty", set Quantity to 1 and click "Save Part".
  11. On [Line-0] open the line's ⋮ menu, click "Save as canned line" and save it under the line's title. [Job-1] = that canned job name.
  12. Go to Work Orders, click "New Work Order", create the customer "ZZAUTOTEST PL CANVEND Customer" and unit "ZZAUTOTEST-PL-CANVEND-UNIT", click Create. [WO-1] = that work order number.
  13. Set [Part-A] inactive: on the Active tab search [Part-A], click its row, pick Part Status "Inactive", click Save, leave the note empty and click "Deactivate" in the "Deactivate part?" confirmation.
  14. Check the setup worked: the [Job-1] suggestion on New Line shows "Total Parts: 2"; [Part-A] is on the Inactive tab.
custom_steps:
1. Open [WO-1].
  2. Click "New Line".
  3. Type the start of [Job-1] in Title and pick the [Job-1] suggestion.
  4. Click "Save & Close".
  5. Read the warning at the bottom right.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 4: The new line [Job-1] holds [Part-C] only; the vendor part [Typed-1] is not on it.
  • Step 5: One warning shows, starting "These parts are inactive and were not added:" and naming the left-out part. It stays until closed.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v26 (Ready for dev), S9-R9a, S9-R10, read 8 Oct 2026; design canvas none (boards 6.4 and 6.5 show an inventory part, not a typed vendor part). Source-verified 8 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-R9a: “A canned job part that was typed in as a vendor part, and whose number matches an inactive part at this location, is left out too.”
  • PRD Story 9 context note: “in S9-R9a, S9-R15, S9-R16 and S9-R17 a number "matches" an inactive part when the two are the same once upper and lower case, hyphens, asterisks, periods and spaces are ignored. A number that also belongs to an active part at this location is not refused.”
  • S9-R10: “When a canned job leaves out parts, the system shows one warning listing every part left out: "These parts are inactive and were not added: {part numbers}." The warning stays until the user closes it.”
